question: The Mughals were descendants of ______ from their father’s side.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Timur.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Mughals** were a dynasty that ruled India from the early **16th to mid-19th century,** and their founder Babur claimed **Timur as his ancestor.**
 
• Babur's father **Umar Sheikh Mirza** was a direct descendant of **Timur's son Miran Shah,** making Babur a Timurid prince. 
 
• Babur's mother **Qutlugh Nigar Khanum** was a descendant of **Genghis Khan, **but this lineage was not emphasized as much as the Timurid connection. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Timur (also known as Tamerlane) **was a **Turkic-Mongol conqueror **who founded the **Timurid Empire** in Persia and Central Asia.
 
• **Muhammad Ghori **was a ruler of the **Ghurid dynasty in Afghanistan** and India who defeated** Prithviraj Chauhan** in the Second Battle of Tarain and established **Muslim rule in Delhi. **
 
• **Genghis Khan **was the founder and first emperor of the **Mongol Empire, **which at its height controlled much of Asia and Europe.
 
• **Mahmud of Ghazni **was a Sultan of the **Ghaznavid Empire in Afghanistan **and India who conducted several raids into India and patronized **Persian culture and literature.**
